name: Vincent Ngo
summary: iOS applications engineer, co-founder, and author.

education.qualification: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
education.details: Graduated May 2014 · Minor in Mathematics · GPA: 3.65/4.0 overall, 3.61/4.0 in major · Blacksburg, VA
education.activities: Computer Science Community Service (CS²), Web Development Group, ACM, and hackathons including MHacks, PennApps, HackNC, and HackVT.

education.details: Completed undergraduate-level computer science courses while enrolled in high school.

awards.title: Capital One Identity Hackathon · First place
awards.description: Won first place for a liveness verification prototype that recorded randomly prompted facial gestures and detected multiple people in view to distinguish a live person from a static photo.

awards.title: VT Hacks · Fitnet award
awards.description: Won first place for the most creative app incorporating multiple workout motivators. Built Project Ham with a team: an iOS workout companion with scheduling, alerts, and a virtual hamster whose fitness reflects the user's workout habits.

experience.description: Co-founded Good Journey Software to build a ground transportation operating system and global supplier network, with the goal of making rides bookable anywhere in the world.
Turn complex mobile development concepts into practical tutorials and books that help developers build apps with iOS, Swift, and Flutter.

Worked across iOS applications, backend microservices, identity and secure authentication services, Presto, and contactless payments and verification, while mentoring engineers and giving tech talks at Dev Days.
Built iOS interfaces for Capital One Wallet and the flagship app, and created the entire UI for T&EZ from scratch to help corporate travelers manage mileage, expenses, and receipts.

Developed enterprise mobile features for IBM Connections and IBM Verse across iOS and Android—including email management, contacts, calendars, and instant messaging—collaborating with product, design, and backend teams to improve responsiveness, reliability, and usability across multiple releases.
Built front-end features for Mail Pilot 2 on iPhone and iPad, contributing to the app's mobile email experience.

experience.role: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant · CS 3714, Mobile Development
experience.description: Helped students turn mobile development concepts into working iOS apps through project guidance, feedback, and hands-on programming assignments.
Explored new iOS experiences for USA Today and built tools to capture and email console logs, helping developers investigate app issues.

research.description: Contributed to Virtual Town Square, a project exploring online community interaction and civic engagement, with Dr. Andrea L. Kavanaugh and Dr. Manuel A. Pérez-Quiñones at Virginia Tech.

research.organization: Mobile Software Engineering Lab · Virginia Tech
research.description: Explored iOS 6 features with Dr. Osman Balci, built example apps and tutorials, and supported students through teaching assistant workshops, coursework creation, grading, and office hours.

publications.title: Flutter Apprentice
publications.description: A hands-on guide that takes developers from Flutter fundamentals to building apps for iOS and Android from a single codebase.

publications.title: Data Structures & Algorithms in Swift
publications.description: A practical guide to choosing and implementing data structures and algorithms in Swift, helping developers solve problems and build more efficient apps.

publications.title: iOS 9 by Tutorials
publications.description: Co-authored a practical guide that helps developers turn the new iOS 9 APIs into features for their own apps.

publications.title: How to Create an iOS Book Open Animation
publications.description: A step-by-step tutorial that brings a book-opening interaction to life in an iOS app.

publications.title: Introducing iOS Design Patterns in Swift
publications.description: A practical introduction to using design patterns in Swift to give iOS app code a clearer, more maintainable structure.

publications.title: iOS 8 by Tutorials
publications.description: Co-authored a guide to adopting iOS 8 APIs through working examples in Swift and Objective-C.

publications.title: NSScanner Tutorial: Parsing Data in Mac OS X
publications.description: A hands-on tutorial that shows developers how to turn text into structured data with NSScanner on macOS.

patents.title: Systems and methods for transaction card-based authentication
patents.description: Co-invented an NFC challenge-response method that authenticates a transaction card using a user's device.

patents.title: Computing systems utilizing generated unique authorization identifiers for authorizing user operations and methods of use thereof
